subject: Compute ready for review: 3 blockers fixed, ABI 1184/11592, real producer 7/7, graphics sidecar
body:
Work is ready for review/integration. No phone/native/publish/commit. STATUS: gpu/build/deepseek-parallel-20261025/workers/compute/STATUS.md.

FIXED AGAINST THE FINAL BRIDGE
- combined sampler_index 0..15, plus bound Metal slot ranges;
- declared wire span + level offset is the n2t layout bound (span1023 vs layout1024 refuses);
- nonzero and explicit-zero swizzle via additive TDG2 flag 0x2000 (lowering ACKed e321e8da; compiler manifest unchanged).
My C suite release+ASan is PASS, including the explicit-zero-swizzle descriptor check.

ABI/PLANNER
- ComputeRegion 1184 (local[3]); NativeDispatchV2 11592 (header 72, descriptors@72, regions@2120). Exact line r=160 d=64 reg=1184 v=11592 vh=36 desc=72 regions=2120 flags=24 cc=28 const=32 push=1056.
- local comes from SpecKey::LocalSize declarations per region, not hardcoded IDs; 17x9 TestFastMath returns 8x4,8x1,1x4,1x1. Frontend compares package local to plan.regions[r].local.
- Additive graphics API: tegu_air_render_pipeline_plan_generic_specialized returns unchanged GenericPlan plus GraphicsSpecializationPlan (3360B): independent VS/FS SpecId tables, exact Vk/Metal view formats, compare flag, planner key. It admits real linear/ASTC facts; old plan_generic remains default-only. Real authored probe test passes; no nearest projection.

TESTS (actual)
- Rust `cargo test --release`: 21/21 PASS; new cdylib 2aa21057... (worker air-work/src/lib.rs byte-equal to production air_bridge.rs b143aca5...).
- Real frozen compiler ea4454b7... + new producer: 7/7 real producer cases PASS (nearest/linear, four exact-thread regions, accumulate); each package local matches its own region specialization.
- C `check_compute_v2.py` release+ASan/UBSan PASS; frontend v1 aligned host harness PASS.
- `gpu/tests/metal_resource_integration_test.py` with 2aa21057: ABI PASS 160/64/1184/11592, TGP2 156/156, producer 47/47, job 111 checks with ONE required failure. It is the integration test stale v10 plane word7 (`want 000f000f`, got 0); textures intentionally zeroes the arch9/v2 word7 and the suite full-v9 oracle passes. integration_tests: please split/update that expectation. Everything else is green, release+ASan no sanitizer finding. Reports /tmp/opencode/integration-full3.json and /tmp/opencode/real-producer-new/result.json.

PRODUCTION HASHES
pipeline_format.h e321e8da..., air_bridge.h cbc9c28e..., air_bridge.rs b143aca5..., nord2_metal_bridge.c ae293c43..., nord2_metal_bridge.h 71a874c1..., compute_frontend.m 14766d48..., runtime_pipeline.inc cad3849b..., cdylib 2aa21057....

REMAINING EXPLICIT
- Full mip wire / >16 layers / atomic RMW transport; sampler custom-border/integer-ClampZero paths still refuse; opaque black/white ClampZero now maps to ClampBorder.
- Render must consume the new sidecar with tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_specialized(_rt), never unspecialized; generic mips/array/MS remain refused until render transport wiring.
- Compute producer cannot express explicit zero swizzle yet (wire flag exists; Rust resource has no valid bit); nonzero is accepted for compatibility.
- Integration word7 test update; native build/device still root-only. No hardware claim. Root: please rebuild the native Rust lib from b143aca5... (old 4bad3821 is ABI-stale) and integrate.
